oromo: Dubartii ulfa kan taate fiisxiniimtuun tokko, loltootni Israa'el daandii cufan irratti ambulaansii ishee daqiiqaa 30 ol waan turcaniif mucaa ishee garaa keessatti du'e deesseetti. Haati ishee haala tasgabbaa'aa keessa kan jirtu ta'us, ogeeyyiin fayyaa tursiisuun kun tajaajila hatattamaa fayyaa gufachiisuu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: US Senator Graham offered military support for Israeli war on Lebanon, new footage shows
english: Newly released documentary footage shows US Senator Lindsey Graham expressing support for military conflicts in Iran and Lebanon. In one recorded conversation, Graham unilaterally offered Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu direct US military assistance for the campaign in Lebanon. These clips were captured by filmmaker Alex Holder, who had extensive access to Graham's private meetings and discussions with world leaders.

title: Israeli election campaign billboards in Cyprus spark debate
english: Israeli politician Gadi Eisenkot is facing criticism for placing political campaign billboards in Cyprus that target Israeli tourists traveling through Larnaca airport. Local official Fidias Panayiotou condemned the move, arguing that using foreign territory for domestic political campaigning violates national sovereignty. While many Israelis visit the island for vacations, officials insist that the country should not be used as a platform for Israeli electioneering.

title: UN experts urge Iran to halt death sentences of 10 men
english: A group of United Nations experts is demanding that Iran stop the execution of ten young men who were sentenced following anti-government demonstrations. The officials criticized the legal process, noting that the closed trials lacked transparency and failed to meet international fair trial requirements. This plea follows the earlier execution of two other young men who were part of the same group of twelve defendants.

title: Wildfire now nine miles away from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
english: A massive wildfire in France’s Gironde region has reached within nine miles of Bordeaux, prompting city officials to prepare for potential mass evacuations. Firefighters are struggling to contain the blaze, which has already destroyed over 40,000 hectares and hundreds of homes. Authorities warn that this is an unprecedented fire season, with many incidents linked to human carelessness or intentional arson.

title: Why have US-Lebanon direct flights been banned for 40 years?
english: Direct flights between the United States and Lebanon have been prohibited for forty years following the hijacking of TWA Flight 847 in the 1980s. This long-standing security restriction was recently addressed by Donald Trump, who indicated that these aviation connections could now be re-established. The ban had remained in place for decades as a significant safety measure after the initial incident.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በሊባኖስ መካከል የነበረው ቀጥታ የበረራ አገልግሎት በ1980ዎቹ የTWA በረራ 847 ታግቶ በመወሰዱ ምክንያት ለአርባ ዓመታት ታግዶ ቆይቷል። ይህ ለረጅም ዓመታት የቆየ የደህንነት እገዳ በቅርቡ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ትኩረት የተደረገበት ሲሆን፣ የበረራ ግንኙነቶቹ እንደገና ሊቀጥሉ እንደሚችሉ ተገልጿል። እገዳው ከተፈጠረው አደጋ በኋላ እንደ ዋና የደህንነት ጥንቃቄ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ተግባራዊ ሆኖ ቆይቷል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri kallattiin Ameerikaa fi Libaanoon gidduutti taasifamu, erga xiyyaarri TWA 847 bara 1980ota keessa butamee booda waggoota afurtamaaf dhorkamee ture. Dhorkaan nageenyaa yeroo dheeraaf ture kun dhiheenya kana Donald Trumpin kaasamee, hariiroon balalii kun ammas itti fufuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Dhorkaan kun erga balaan sun mudatee booda tarkaanfii nageenyaa cimaa ta'ee waggoota dheeraaf hojiirra ture.

title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir opens polls in violence-wracked vote
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir has begun the first of three rounds of local legislative elections amid a period of intense instability and violence. Dozens of people have died in recent weeks during protests, prompting authorities to implement strict security measures and internet blackouts. These disruptions have made campaigning difficult for candidates and have raised concerns about the overall impact on the electoral process.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር የሚገኘው ካሽሚር ከሳምንታት የዘለቀ ግጭትና የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት በኋላ፣ የክልላዊ ምክር ቤት ምርጫን ማካሄድ ጀምሯል። በቅርቡ በተቀሰቀሱ ተቃውሞዎች ምክንያት የጸጥታ ሁኔታው በመባባሱ ምርጫው በሶስት ዙር እንዲካሄድ ተወስኗል። ባለስልጣናት በክልሉ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎትን በመገደባቸው እና ጥብቅ የጸጥታ እርምጃዎችን በመውሰዳቸው፣ የምርጫ ሂደቱ እና የዘመቻ ስራዎች ላይ ተጽዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Kaashmiir kutaadhaan Pakistan jala jirtu keessatti, guyyoota darban keessa walitti buiinsa fi balaa lubbuu darbe hedduu booda, filannoon bakka bu’oota naannoo marsaa jalqabaa gaggeeffamaa jira. Mootummaan tasgabbii mirkaneessuuf jecha filannicha marsaa sadiin akka gaggeeffamu kan murteesse yoo ta'u, intarneetiin akka dhaabbatu fi tarkaanfiin nageenyaa cimaan akka fudhatamu godheera. Haalli kun duula filannoo irratti dhiibbaa kan uume yoo ta'u, adeemsi filannichaa yaaddoo keessa akka galu taasiseera.

title: Are the US and Iran heading towards a forever war?
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated following nearly two weeks of American airstrikes targeting Iranian civilian infrastructure. Iran has retaliated by attacking the critical facilities of US allies in the Gulf region. President Trump has signaled a potential increase in these attacks, fueling concerns that the two nations are spiraling into a long-term, large-scale military conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ግንኙነት በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ በተፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ ወደ ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ገብቷል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የኢራንን መሠረተ ልማቶች ኢላማ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ኢራንም በምላሹ በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ አጋሮች ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ጥቃቱን የበለጠ ለማጠናከር ማቀዳቸው ስጋት ፈጥሯል፣ ይህም ሁለቱ አገራት ወደማያባራ ጦርነት ሊያመሩ እንደሚችሉ እየተነገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hariiroon Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru erga Ameerikaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwattee asitti kan caalaatti hammaatee jira. Iraanis deebii kennuuf jecha biyyoota Galdii keessa jiran kanneen michoota Ameerikaa ta'an irratti haleellaa raawwachaa jirti. Preezdaant Traamp haleellaa kana kan caalaatti jabessuuf yaadachuu isaanii hordofee, biyyoonni lameen kun gara waraana waggoota dheeraa fiduu danda'uutti imalaa jiraachuu isaanii sodaan jira.

title: Lebanon’s displaced endure ‘exhaustion and despair’
english: The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Turk, has highlighted the severe suffering of Lebanese families displaced by ongoing Israeli military strikes. These individuals have been forced to relocate repeatedly, leading to widespread mental trauma and physical fatigue. Turk is calling for a lasting ceasefire to ensure these families can finally return to their homes in safety.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር ቮልከር ቱርክ፣ በእስራኤል ጥቃት ምክንያት የተፈናቀሉ የሊባኖስ ቤተሰቦች ከፍተኛ ስቃይ ውስጥ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። እነዚህ ተፈናቃዮች በተደጋጋሚ ከመኖሪያቸው በመፈናቀላቸው ለከፍተኛ የአካልና የአእምሮ ድካም ተጋልጠዋል። ኮሚሽነሩ ቤተሰቦቹ በሰላም ወደ ቤታቸው እንዲመለሱ ዘላቂ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት እንዲከበር አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Komishinarri olaanaan mirga namoomaa kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Volker Turk, maatiin Libaanoos weerara Israa'eliin qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'an harka qullaa fi miidhaa guddaa keessa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Namoonni kunneen yeroo hedduu bakka tokkoo gara birootti baqachuun dadhabbii fi miira yaaddoo cimaa keessa akka jiran eerameera. Komishinarichi maatiin kunneen nagaan gara qe'ee isaaniitti akka deebi'anuf, waraanni dhaabbatee tasgabbiin akka bu'u gaafataniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia defends against drone strikes from ‘Iran-backed’ groups
english: Saudi Arabia successfully intercepted drone attacks targeting its oil infrastructure, attributing the strikes to Iran-supported factions in Iraq. Similar drone incidents were also reported in Jordan and northern Iraq, raising concerns that militant groups may be testing the current fragile pause in hostilities between the United States and Iran. While the Iraqi government has pledged to investigate the origins of the strikes, these events highlight ongoing instability and regional security challenges.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በነዳጅ ማቀነባበሪያዎቿ ላይ ያነጣጠሩ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን መክታት ችላለች፤ ጥቃቱንም በኢራቅ በሚገኙ በኢራን በሚደገፉ ታጣቂዎች ላይ አሳብባለች። ተመሳሳይ የድሮን ጥቃቶች በዮርዳኖስ እና በሰሜን ኢራቅ መፈጸማቸው፣ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ወቅታዊ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት የተኩስ አቁም እየተፈታተኑት እንደሆነ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የኢራቅ መንግስት ጥቃቶቹ ከየት እንደመጡ ለማጣራት ቃል የገባ ቢሆንም፣ ክስተቶቹ በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት እና የጸጥታ ችግሮች ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan miidhaa buufataalee boba'aa ishee irratti karoorfamee ture drone'iin qolachuushee beeksisite; qilleensa irraas kan haleele garee Iraaniin deeggaraman kan Iraaq keessa jiran ta'uu himte. Haleellaan drone'ii walfakkaataan Yordaanosii fi kaaba Iraaq keessatti gabaafamuun, gareewwan hidhatan kunneen waldhabdee Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti uumamee jiruufi tasgabbii yeroodhaa argame qormaata keessa galchaa jiraachuu isaanii shakkisiiseera. Mootummaan Iraaq haleellaan kun eessaa akka dhufan qorachuu isaa kan ibse ta'us, taateewwan kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu naannichaa kan agarsiisaniidha.

title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
english: Ukraine has rejected Iranian threats following a drone strike on a cargo ship in the Caspian Sea that Kyiv claims was transporting military supplies to Russia. Ukrainian officials argue that Tehran is an active partner in Russia's war effort by providing weaponry, including drones and missiles. This operation marks a significant escalation by linking the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran through the disruption of a key Russian-Iranian supply route.
amharic: ዩክሬን በካስፒያን ባህር ውስጥ ለሩሲያ ወታደራዊ ቁሳቁሶችን ይዞ ሲጓዝ በነበረ የጭነት መርከብ ላይ የደረሰውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ኢራን የሰነዘረችውን ማስፈራሪያ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። የዩክሬን ባለሥልጣናት ኢራን ድሮኖችን እና ሚሳይሎችን በማቅረብ በሩሲያ የጦርነት ጥረት ውስጥ ንቁ ተሳታፊ እንደሆነች ይናገራሉ። ይህ የዩክሬን እርምጃ በሩሲያ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ወሳኝ የአቅርቦት መስመር በማስተጓጎል በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የጦርነት ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ግልጽ አድርጎታል።
oromo: ዩክሬን ባህር ካስፒያን ውስጥ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ተከትሎ ኢራን ለሰነዘረችው ማስፈራሪያ ምላሽ ሰጥታለች። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት ኢራን ድሮንና ሚሳይሎችን ለሩሲያ በማቅረብ የጦርነቱ ተባባሪ ናት ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ይህ ድርጊት በሩሲያ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ወሳኝ የጦር መሳሪያ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በማወክ፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት በይፋ ያሳየ ክስተት ሆኗል።

title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
english: Police in Toronto are investigating after shots were fired at the US consulate building for the second time this year. A witness observed a white car speeding away from the scene early Monday morning, but authorities chose not to pursue it further due to public safety risks. No one was harmed during the incident, and officials are currently working with national and international partners to identify the suspects.
amharic: የቶሮንቶ ፖሊስ በዚህ ዓመት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በአሜሪካ ቆንስላ ህንጻ ላይ የተኩስ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው። ሰኞ ማለዳ ላይ አንድ ነጭ መኪና ከቦታው በፍጥነት ሲሸሽ ቢታይም፣ የጸጥታ ስጋትን በመፍራት ፖሊስ ማሳደዱን አቁሟል። በዚህ ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው የለም፤ ባለስልጣናትም ወንጀለኞችን ለመያዝ ከአገር ውስጥ እና ከዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ጋር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Poolisiin magaalaa Torontoo bara kana keessatti si'a lammaffaadhaaf konsilaata Ameerikaa irratti dhukaasni banamuu isaa qorachaa jira. Miidhaan qaamaa namarra ga'e hin jiru, qaamoleen mootummaas shakkamtoota to'annoo jala oolchuuf gargaarsa qaamolee biyya keessaa fi idil-addunyaa waliin hojjechaa jiru.

title: New UK PM Burnham assures Zelenskyy of continuing Ukraine support
english: New UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham met with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to reaffirm Britain's absolute commitment to supporting Ukraine against the ongoing Russian invasion. During their visit to a naval training base, Burnham announced that the UK will provide Ukraine with advanced technology to help counter Russian drones. Zelenskyy traveled to the UK ahead of his upcoming meetings in Washington, as he seeks to strengthen international efforts to secure a peaceful resolution to the war.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም አዲሱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ጋር ተገናኝተው ብሪታንያ በሩሲያ ወረራ ላይ ላለችው ዩክሬን ያላትን ሙሉ ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል። በባህር ኃይል ማሰልጠኛ ጣቢያ ጉብኝታቸው ወቅት፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ዩክሬን የሩሲያን ድሮኖች ለመከላከል የሚያስችል ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ እንደሚያቀርቡ ገልጸዋል። ዘሌንስኪ በዋሽንግተን ከሚኖራቸው ቀጣይ ንግግሮች በፊት፣ ለአገራቸው ዘላቂ ሰላም ፍለጋ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍን ለማጠናከር ወደ እንግሊዝ አቅንተዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa UK haaraa Andy Burnham fi pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodymyr Zelenskyy wal arguun, UK Yukreen weerara Raashiyaa ittisuu irratti gargaarsa guutuu gochuuf waadaa galte jirti. Daawwannaa buufata leenjii galaanaa irratti, muummeen ministirichaa UK teeknooloojii ammayyaa xiyyaara maleeyyii Raashiyaa ittisuuf gargaaru Yukreeniif akka kennitu beeksisaniiru. Zelenskyy marii Waashingtonitti godhamuun dura, walitti bu'iinsa kana nagaadhaan xumuruuf deeggarsa idil-addunyaa cimsuuf gara UK kan deeman.

title: Will UNESCO’s heritage listing halt Israeli plans for West Bank’s Sebastia?
english: UNESCO has officially designated the ancient site of Sebastia in the West Bank as a World Heritage site in danger to help protect it from Israeli expansion. Palestinian officials hope this international recognition will prevent Israel from seizing the land and moving forward with settlement projects that threaten both the historic ruins and local tourism. Israel has criticized the move as politically motivated, while residents fear that proposed laws could permanently strip them of their authority over this significant archaeological landmark.
amharic: ዩኔስኮ በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን የሴባስቲያ ጥንታዊ ቅርርስፍራ ከእስራኤል መስፋፋት ለመከላከል እንዲረዳ በዓለም ቅርስነት እና በአደጋ ላይ እንዳለ ቅርስነት መዝግቦታል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ውሳኔ እስራኤል መሬቱን ከመውረስ እና ቅርስነቱን አደጋ ላይ ከሚጥሉ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶች እንድትቆጠብ ያደርጋል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ። እስራኤል ውሳኔውን ፖለቲካዊ ነው ስትል ትቃወመዋለች፤ የሀገር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች ግን አዲሱ የእስራኤል ህግ በቅርስ ስፍራው ላይ ያላቸውን አስተዳደራዊ ስልጣን ሊነጥቃቸው እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: UNESCO’n lafa durii Sebastiyaa kan naannoo Lixaa (West Bank) jiru, babal'ina Israa'el irraa eeguuf jecha akka lafa dhaala addunyaa fi lafa balaa keessa jiruutti galmeesseera. Qaamoleen mootummaa Filisxeem tarkaanfii kanaan Israa'el laficha fudhachuu fi pirojektiiwwan qubannaa lafa sanaa fi seenaa isaa miidhan akka dhaabdu abdii qabu. Israa'el tarkaanfichaan kun siyaasa irratti kan xiyyeeffate jedhee kan mormu yoo ta'u, jiraattonni naannichaa garuu seera haaraa Israa'el baasuuf karoorfatte kanatti aansuun aangoosaanii kan lafa arkeolojiichaa irratti qaban akka dhaban sodaatu.

title: What drove Venezuela’s decision to leave the ICC?
english: Venezuela has formally initiated its withdrawal from the International Criminal Court, with officials citing a perceived bias against nations in the Global South. While the country's leadership describes this move as irreversible, the ICC stated that ongoing investigations into alleged crimes against humanity will proceed unaffected. Experts note that this decision reflects a shifting foreign policy in Caracas, though legal provisions ensure the court maintains its jurisdiction over current cases for at least one year.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ ያላት አድልዎ አለ የሚል ክስ በማቅረብ ከፍርድ ቤቱ በይፋ እንደምትወጣ አስታውቃለች። የሀገሪቱ መንግስት ይህንን ውሳኔ የማይቀለበስ ሲል ቢገልጸውም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ግን በሀገሪቱ ላይ የተጀመሩ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ምርመራዎች በውሳኔው እንደማይገቱ ገልጿል። በህጉ መሰረት የሀገር መልቀቅ ውሳኔ ተግባራዊ የሚሆነው ከአንድ አመት በኋላ በመሆኑ፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ በወቅቱ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ጉዳዮች ላይ ስልጣኑን እንደያዘ ይቆያል።
oromo: Venezuuelaan murtii mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) irratti, biyyoota giddu-galeessa fi kibbaa addunyaa irratti loogii raawwata jechuun mana murtichaa gadhiisuuf murteessiteetti. Mootummaan biyyattii murtin kun kan hin jijjiiramne akka ta'e ibsus, mana murtichi garuu qorannoon yakka suukanneessaa irratti eegale akka itti fufu beeksisera. Seerichaan, biyyi tokko mana murtichaa gadi dhiisuuf yeroo waggaa tokko kan fudhatu waan ta'eef, mana murtichi qorannoo isaa itti fufuuf aangoo guutuu qaba.

title: India suspends police officer for firing AK-47 at student protesters
english: An Indian police officer has been suspended following the use of an AK-47 against students who were demonstrating against exam paper leaks. The protests have caused significant political fallout, including the resignation of the country's education minister. Authorities are now facing public criticism for employing excessive force against the student protesters.
amharic: በህንድ ፈተናዎች መለቀቃቸውን በመቃወም ላይ በነበሩ ተማሪዎች ላይ የAK-47 ጥይት የተኮሰው የፖሊስ አባል ከስራ ታግዷል። የተማሪዎቹ ተቃውሞ የሀገሪቱ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር እንዲለቁ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናቱ በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የሃይል እርምጃ በመውሰዳቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti qabxii qormaataa ba'uun (leaked) mormuudhaan barattoonni hiriira ba'an irratti humna waraanaatti fayyadamee dhukaasa kan banne poolisiin tokko hojiirraa uggurameera. Mormii kana hordofee ministeerri barnootaa biyyattii aangoo gadi liiqeera. Mootummaan barattoota irratti humni garmalee fayyadame jechuun qaamoleen mirga namoomaa fi hawaasni mormii guddaa kaasaniiru.

title: Chad to join raft of withdrawals from International Criminal Court
english: Chad has officially initiated the process to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, becoming the fifth nation to do so recently. The military government cited concerns over the court's perceived bias toward African nations and its overall lack of effectiveness. This move follows significant diplomatic pressure from the United States, which has actively campaigned against the tribunal's operations.
amharic: ቻድ ዓለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤትን (ICC) ለቃ ለመውጣት ሂደቱን መጀመሯን ይፋ አድርጋለች፤ ይህም በቅርቡ ፍርድ ቤቱን የለቀቀች አምስተኛዋ ሀገር አድርጓታል። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ መንግስት ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰደው ፍርድ ቤቱ በአፍሪካ ሀገራት ላይ አድልዎ ያደርጋል በሚል ቅሬታ እና በውጤታማነት ላይ ባለው ክፍተት ምክንያት ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው አሜሪካ በዓለም አቀፍ ፍርድ ቤቱ ላይ ባሳደረችው ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ተጽዕኖ መሆኑ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Chaad mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) keessaa ba'uuf adeemsa eegalte jirti; kunis biyya shanaffaa yeroo dhiyootti dhaabbata kana gadhiifte taateerti. Mootummaan waraanaa biyyattii tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, mana murtichi biyyoota Afrikaa irratti loogii raawwata fi bu'aa qabeessa miti jedhee waan amanuufi. Murteen kun kan dhufe erga mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiibbaa cimaa mana murticha irratti gochuu eegalee booda.

title: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
english: Severe wildfires are ravaging France and Spain following record-breaking summer heatwaves, leading to the displacement of over 300,000 residents. The fires have destroyed massive areas of land and triggered rare fire-generated thunderstorms, which complicate firefighting efforts by potentially sparking new blazes. Authorities are currently deploying specialized aircraft to drop water and fire retardant in a desperate attempt to contain the flames.
amharic: በአውሮፓ እየተከሰተ ያለው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት በፈረንሳይ እና በስፔን አስከፊ የደን ቃጠሎ አስከትሎ ከ300,000 በላይ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። ቃጠሎው በራሱ የሚፈጥራቸውን መብረቅ እና አውሎ ንፋስ ጨምሮ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታዎችን በመፍጠሩ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ልዩ አውሮፕላኖችን በመጠቀም ውሃ እና የእሳት መከላከያ ኬሚካሎችን በመርጨት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ho'i daangaa darbe Awurooppaa keessatti muudate biyyoota Faransaayii fi Ispeen keessatti ibidda bosonaa hamaa kaasee, namoonni 300,000 ol ta'an manaa isaanii akka godaanaan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun haala qilleensa hamaa fi ofii isaatii obomboleettii uumuun akka babal'atu waan ta'eef, to'achuun isaa ulfaataa ta'eera. Aangeyyoonni ibidda kana dhaamsuuf xiyyaara adda fayyadamuun bishaan fi qoricha ibidda dhaamsu roobsuun tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Chile captures fugitive convicted of singer Victor Jara's murder under Pinochet
english: Chilean authorities have apprehended Nelson Haase, a former military officer who had been on the run after receiving a 25-year prison sentence for his role in the 1973 murder and kidnapping of folk singer Victor Jara. Jara was a famous activist killed by the Pinochet regime shortly after the military coup. Haase, who disappeared when his final sentence was confirmed in 2023, was finally located by police in the southern part of the country.
amharic: የቺሊ ፖሊስ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1973 በፒኖቼ አገዛዝ ወቅት የታዋቂውን ድምፃዊ ቪክቶር ጃራን ግድያ እና ታፍኖ መወሰድ ተካፋይ በመሆን የ25 ዓመት እስራት የተፈረደበትን ኔልሰን ሃሴን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ሃሴ የፍርድ ውሳኔው ሲተላለፍ ከፍትህ አካላት ተሰውሮ የቆየ ሲሆን፣ ባለፈው ቅዳሜ በሀገሪቱ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ተገኝቷል። ቪክቶር ጃራ በወቅቱ በነበረው ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ከተገደሉ በርካታ ሰዎች መካከል አንዱ ሲሆን፣ ግድያው የአገዛዙን ጭካኔ ከሚያሳዩ ዋና ዋና ክስተቶች አንዱ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Chiilii, ajjeechaa fi butii sirba-gaa fi waltajii wallee Victor Jara bara 1973tti raawwatamee ture irratti hirmaachuun waggaa 25 hidhaatti murteeffamee ture Nelson Haase to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Haase murtiin hidhaa kun erga ragga'ee booda bilxigoo ta'ee badee ture; garuu guyyaa Dilbataa kutaa kibba biyyattii keessatti argameera. Victor Jara sirreessaa fi qabsoo siyaasaa kan ture yoo ta'u, ajjeechaan isaa mootummaa diktaatoraa Piinoochee jalatti namoota hedduu irratti miidhaa gurguddaa qaqqabeef fakkeenya guddaa ta'eera.

title: Israeli raid sparks fire at UN Palestinian refugee centre
english: Israeli forces conducted a raid on a United Nations facility for Palestinian refugees located in East Jerusalem. During the operation, authorities used tear gas and stun grenades, leading to the detention of staff members and the outbreak of a fire. This incident occurred shortly after Israel announced its intention to tear down the building.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኝ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ማሰልጠኛ ማዕከል ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ወታደሮቹ ባደረጉት እንቅስቃሴ አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና የድምጽ ቦምቦችን በመጠቀማቸው የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፣ በተጨማሪም የድርጅቱ ሰራተኞች ታስረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው እስራኤል ህንጻውን ለማፍረስ እቅድ እንዳላት ካስታወቀች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el iddoo leenjii gargaarsa baqattoota Filisxeem kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii (UN) magaala Yerusaalem bahaa keessatti argamu haleelanii jiru. Hojiin kun gaazii imimmaansisuu fi boba'aa sagalee cimaa uumu fayyadamuudhaan kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, hojjettootni qabamanii ibiddi ka'uun isaas gabaafameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, Israa'el bakka sana diiguuf karoorfachuu ishee erga beeksistee boodadha.

title: Mapping Israeli settler violence in the West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have intensified their violent activities in the West Bank, recently setting fire to two mosques and leaving racist graffiti. UN data highlights a significant increase in such attacks, with thousands of incidents reported since early 2025. These tensions reached a deadly point in the village of Tal, where clashes between residents and settlers resulted in several deaths.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚኖሩ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች የሁለት መስጊዶችን በእሳት በማቃጠል እና ዘረኛ ጽሁፎችን በመጻፍ ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው ከ2025 መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። በታል መንደር በተፈጠረ ግጭትም በነዋሪዎችና በሰፋሪዎች መካከል በተደረገው ፍጥጫ የበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል።
oromo: Qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti masjidota lama gubuufi barreeffamoota jibbaa barreessuun haleellaa isaanii daran hammaachiisaniiru. Odeeffannoon Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka agarsiisutti, jalqaba bara 2025 irraa eegalee haleellaan akkasii kumaan lakkaa'amu raawwatameera. Gandoota naannoo sanaatti uummataafi qubattoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera.

title: How Israel uses settler-soldier terror to colonise the West Bank
english: The article argues that recent violence in the West Bank is not a series of isolated incidents, but a coordinated strategy of colonization. Israeli forces and settlers work in tandem to systematically displace Palestinians, weaken local infrastructure, and seize territory. Officials frame these aggressive actions as security measures, yet they represent a calculated effort to expand settlements and redefine the land.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በዌስት ባንክ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ተያያዥነት የሌላቸው ክስተቶች ሳይሆኑ፣ የተቀነባበረ የቅኝ ግዛት ስትራቴጂ መሆኑን ይገልጻል። የእስራኤል ጦር እና ሰፋሪዎች በመተባበር ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመሬታቸው ለማፈናቀል፣ መሰረተ ልማቶችን ለማዳከም እና መሬትን ለመውሰድ እየሰሩ ነው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ጥቃቶች እንደ የጸጥታ እርምጃ ቢገልጹዋቸውም፣ በእውነቱ ግን የሰፈራ መስፋፋትን የሚያፋጥን ስሌት የተሞላበት አካሄድ ነው።
oromo: Barruun kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo West Bank keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun gocha tasaa osoo hin taane, tarsiimoo koloniyeeshinii qindaa'aa ta'uu ibsa. Waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni biyyattii giddutti walta'uun, lammiilee Falasxiin lafa isaanii irraa buqqisuuf, bu'uuraalee misoomaa diiguuf fi lafa to'achuuf hojjechaa jiru. Mootummaan gocha kana akka tarkaanfii nageenyaatti yoo dhiyeessus, kun garuu babal'ina qubannaa fi lafa fudhachuuf malaan kan raawwatamu dha.

title: Why Venezuela is leaving the ICC
english: Venezuela has announced its decision to withdraw from the International Criminal Court. The government claims the institution is biased against developing nations in the Global South. This development occurs while the court is already dealing with significant political challenges and internal leadership instability.
amharic: ቬኔዙኤላ ከአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ለመውጣት መወሰኗን አስታውቃለች። መንግስት ፍርድ ቤቱ በማደግ ላይ ባሉ ሀገራት ላይ ወገንተኝነት የተሞላበት አድልዎ እያደረገ ነው በማለት ይከሳል። ይህ ውሳኔ ፍርድ ቤቱ ውስብስብ የፖለቲካ ጫናዎች እና የአመራር ችግሮች በተጋረጡበት ወቅት የመጣ ነው።

title: Why a new war in Yemen could be different for the Houthis
english: Tensions in Yemen are escalating as Houthi forces transition from mobilization to active combat, including attacks on Saudi ships and renewed clashes with government-aligned groups. Although the Houthis have maintained control over northern Yemen for years, the strategic landscape has shifted due to the increased unity of anti-Houthi forces. A full-scale return to war may prove more difficult for the group this time compared to their initial rise to power in 2014.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ ኃይሎች ወደ መጠነ ሰፊ ውጊያ እየተሸጋገሩ በመሆናቸው በአካባቢው ያለው ግጭት ተባብሷል። ምንም እንኳን ሁቲዎች ለዓመታት ሰሜናዊ የመንን በቁጥጥራቸው ስር ቢያቆዩም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የሁቲ ተቃዋሚ ኃይሎች በይበልጥ እየተጠናከሩ በመምጣታቸው ሁኔታው ለእነሱ አስቸጋሪ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል። ይህ አዲስ የጦርነት ስጋት በ2014 ከነበረው ሁኔታ በተለየ መልኩ ለቡድኑ ፈታኝ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Yemen keessatti humnoonni Huutii gara waraana bal'aatti ce'aa waan jiraniif walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hamateera. Huutoonni waggoota hedduuf kaaba Yemen to'achaa turus, yeroo ammaa kanatti humnoonni Huutii mormaan tokkummaan jabachaa waan jiraniif haalli isaan quunnamu duraan caalaa ulfaataa ta'uu danda'a. Guddinni waraana kanaa kan bara 2014 wajjin wal bira qabamee yoo ilaalamu, garee kanaaf akka duraa salphaa akka hin taane beektonni ni ibsu.

title: Tigray’s Youth are Breaking the TPLF’s Narrative Monopoly
english: For decades, the TPLF maintained strict control over Tigray’s political narrative by suppressing independent media and using state-run outlets to spread propaganda. However, the emergence of social media and the activism of young people are now breaking this monopoly, allowing for more diverse political views and open criticism of the party. As the TPLF’s influence declines and its digital strategies falter, it is struggling to maintain authority in an increasingly challenging environment.
amharic: ለበርካታ አሥርተ ዓመታት ሕወሓት ነፃ ሚዲያን በማፈን እና የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙኃንን በመቆጣጠር የክልሉን የፖለቲካ ትረካ በብቸኝነት ሲቆጣጠር ቆይቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መስፋፋት እና የወጣቶች ተሳትፎ ይህንን የቁጥጥር ሥርዓት እየተፈታተኑት ይገኛሉ። የሕወሓት የዲጂታል ፕሮፓጋንዳ አቅም እየተዳከመ በመምጣቱ እና አማራጭ የፖለቲካ ሃሳቦች በመፍለቃቸው፣ ፓርቲው በክልሉ ላይ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ለማስቀጠል ከፍተኛ ትግል እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: waggoota dheeraaf, TPLF miidiyaa bilisaa ukkaamsuud fi miidiyaalee mootummaa to'achuudhaan yaada siyaasaa Tigraay guutummaatti to'achaa ture. Amma garuu, babal'achuu miidiyaalee hawaasaa fi qooda fudhannaa dargaggootaan to'annaan kun cabaa jira. Dhiibbaan dijitaalaa kan TPLF dadhabaa dhufuudhaan, yaada siyaasaa garaa garaa fi mormiin ifatti ba'uu danda'eera; kunis taayitaa TPLF irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Anger, shock and grief - questions remain in the wake of the Berlin Pride attack
english: A violent attack during Berlin Pride resulted in the death of a woman and left dozens injured. The perpetrator, a 21-year-old known to authorities for radical ties and previous crimes, was killed by police shortly after the event. Government officials and the public are now questioning why the suspect had been released on a suspended sentence instead of remaining in prison despite his history of extremist behavior.
amharic: በበርሊን በተካሄደው የኩራት በዓል (Pride) ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት የአንዲት ሴትን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ከ29 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ግለሰብ በፖሊስ የተገደለ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲል በአክራሪነት እና በወንጀል ድርጊቶች ይታወቅ የነበረ ነው። የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት እና ህዝቡ ከፍተኛ የስጋት ምልክቶች የነበሩበት ሰው እንዴት ከእስር ተፈትቶ በነጻ ይንቀሳቀስ እንደነበር እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ayyaana 'Berlin Pride' irratti haleellaa raawwatamee ture irratti dubartiin tokko yoo duutu, namoonni 29 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Haleellaa kana kan raawwate dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 21 fi seenaa yakka akkasumas quunnamtii garee hammaatoo qabu kun, poolisiiin ajjeefameera. Amma mootummaan fi hawaasni, namichi seenaa yakka cimaa qabu kun maaliif mana hidhaa akka hin turree fi akkuma kanaan gadi akka dhiifame gaaffii kaasaa jiru.

title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
english: Since February, over 600 American soldiers have been wounded in the ongoing conflict with Iran. The Pentagon is facing backlash for confusing and opaque casualty reporting, including the sudden reclassification of deceased personnel between different operational categories. Officials have dismissed these statistical inconsistencies as temporary technical issues, though critics argue the administration is failing to provide transparent information about the war.
amharic: ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ በኢራን ላይ በተከፈተው ጦርነት ከ600 በላይ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ቆስለዋል። የፔንታጎን አስተዳደር የሟቾችን እና የቆሰሉትን ቁጥር በማደናገር እና መረጃዎችን በዘፈቀደ በመቀያየር ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የቁጥር መዛባት ጊዜያዊ የቴክኒክ ችግር ሲሉ ቢገልጹትም፣ ተቺዎች ግን አስተዳደሩ ስለ ጦርነቱ ግልጽ መረጃ እየሰጠ አይደለም ሲሉ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: Guraandhala irraa eegalee waraana Iran waliin ta'een waraana Ameerikaa 600 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Pentagooniin lakkoofsa miidhamtootaa fi du'aatii ibsuu irratti rakkoo fi iftoomina dhabuu isaan qeeqamaa jira; keessattuu maqaa du'aa jijjiiruun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa dogoggora lakkoofsaa kana rakkoo teknikaa yeroo gabaabaa ta'uu ibsanus, namoonni biroo garuu mootummaan waa'ee waraanichaa dhugaa akka hin dubbanne cimsanii himatu.

title: Australian court rejects racial discrimination appeal by Pauline Hanson
english: An Australian federal court has dismissed an appeal by politician Pauline Hanson, confirming a previous ruling that she engaged in racial discrimination against Senator Mehreen Faruqi. The legal dispute centered on a 2022 social media post where Hanson told the Muslim senator to return to Pakistan. The judges ruled that the comments were unlawful, rejecting Hanson’s claims that they were protected under free speech, and emphasized that hate speech does not fall under such legal safeguards.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ የፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት ፖለቲከኛዋ ፖሊን ሃንሰን በቀረበችው ይግባኝ ላይ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ ሴናተር መህሪን ፋሩቂ ላይ የዘር መድልዎ ፈጽማለች የሚለውን የቀድሞ ውሳኔ አጽንቷል። የህግ ክርክሩ የተነሳው በ2022 ሃንሰን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ለሙስሊሟ ሴናተር ወደ ፓኪስታን እንድትመለስ በጻፈችው መልእክት ምክንያት ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ የሃንሰን ንግግር በሀሳብ ነጻነት አይጠበቅም በማለት ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ጥላቻን የሚያራምዱ ንግግሮች በህግ እንደማይጠበቁ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mana murtii federaala Awustraaliyaa, politishinii Pooliin Haansan murtii kanaan dura ishee irratti dabarfamee fi ibsa sanyummaa irratti hundaa'e kan senatar Mehreen Faaruuqii irratti raawwatte jedhamee himatameef dhiyeessite dhaga'uu diduun murticha raggaasiseera. title: Israel’s approval of limited Gaza force a calculated manoeuvre, experts say
english: Israel has approved a small-scale pilot project to allow a limited foreign security force into a specific area of Gaza as part of a U.S.-backed peace proposal. Analysts believe this move is a strategic maneuver by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to reduce American diplomatic pressure before his visit to Washington. Experts warn that the initiative is unlikely to lead to lasting peace and may instead serve to further divide the Gaza Strip under strict Israeli control.

title: Dutch pair banned from Bali after run club ‘excludes locals’
english: Indonesian authorities have officially prohibited two Dutch citizens from entering the country again due to their involvement in a controversial running club in Bali. The decision followed widespread public backlash after reports surfaced that the group specifically excluded local residents from its events. Officials took this action after determining that the men's discriminatory practices violated national regulations.

Gochi kun hawaasa biratti mormii guddaa waan kaaseef, mootummaan gochaa gargar qoodiinsa irratti hundaa'e kana raawwachuun isaaniitiin tarkaanfii kana fudhateera.

title: Three killed in suspected shootout in US city of Seattle, police say
english: A violent shootout at the Bite of Seattle food festival has left three people dead and four others injured, including a young child. Police have taken one teenage suspect into custody, while a second individual involved in the incident remains at large. Local officials expressed deep concern regarding the increasing trend of gun violence in the city following this tragedy.
amharic: በሲያትል በተካሄደው የምግብ ፌስቲቫል ላይ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ ልውውጥ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አንድ ህጻን እና ሶስት አዋቂዎችን ጨምሮ አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ፖሊስ ከአጥቂዎቹ አንዱን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ ሁለተኛው ተጠርጣሪ ግን አሁንም በነጻነት ላይ ይገኛል። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር በከተማዋ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የሽጉጥ ጥቃት የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ሀዘን ገልጸዋል።

Poolisiin shakkamaa tokko to'annoo jala oolchuu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, shakkamaan lammaffaan garuu amma iyyuu bakka jiru hin beekamu. Hojjettoonni mootummaa magaalattii rakkoo dhukaasaa magaalicha keessatti dabalaa dhufe kanaaf gadda guddaa kan ibsan yoo ta'u, qorannoon itti fufee akka jiru himaniiru.

title: Houthis launch drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure
english: The Houthi group, backed by Iran, claimed responsibility for a drone strike targeting Saudi Arabian oil infrastructure on Monday. While the Houthis stated they successfully hit sensitive supply facilities, Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed any damage or injuries. Meanwhile, the Saudi government reported intercepting separate drone attacks originating from Iraq and has urged Iraqi officials to stop such hostile activities.

Gama biraatiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaan haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuu Iraq irraa ka'an mootummaa ishee akka dhaabsiisu gaafatteetti.

title: Israeli raids, demolitions continue across occupied West Bank
english: Israeli forces have intensified military operations across the West Bank, including a raid on a UN facility for Palestinian refugees in Qalandiya. During these incursions, troops used tear gas and stun grenades, leading to the detention of staff members and local residents. Similar raids and property demolitions were reported in multiple cities, including Nablus, Jenin, and Ramallah.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ወታደራዊ ዘመቻውን አጠናክሮ የቀጠለ ሲሆን በቃላንድያ የሚገኘውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የስደተኞች ማዕከል ወረራ ፈጽሟል። በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት ወታደሮች የጥቃት ጋዝ በመጠቀም የተባበሩት መንግስታት ሰራተኞችን ጨምሮ በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በናብሉስ፣ በጀኒን እና በራማላህ ከተሞችም መሰል ወረራዎች እና የቤት ማፍረስ ተግባራት መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhiyaa (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa isaanii daran jabeessaniiru; keessattuu qubsuma Qalandiyaa keessatti bakka bu'oota gamtaa mootummootaatti weerara raawwataniiru. Tarkaanfii kanaan hojjettoota dhaabbatichaa fi jiraattota naannoo sanaa hedduu kan qaban yoo ta'u, gazii fi meeshaalee waraana kan biroos itti fayyadamaniiru. Magaalota akka Naablus, Jenin fi Ramallah keessattis weeraraa fi mancaatii manneenii raawwachuun gabaafameera.

title: Karim Khan dared to hold Israel to account - and that's why he was brought down
english: International Criminal Court Prosecutor Karim Khan has been dismissed following an intense 18-month campaign by Israel and its allies to stop him from pursuing arrest warrants against Israeli officials. Despite allegations of misconduct used to justify his removal, reports suggest these claims were politically motivated to discredit his legal actions regarding the situation in Palestine. This unprecedented pressure included direct intimidation, threats of sanctions from foreign governments, and a coordinated media effort to undermine his authority.

title: Israel attacks civilians sheltering at UN school in Gaza, while separate strike kills two
english: Israeli forces launched an attack on Palestinian civilians gathered near a UN-run school in central Gaza, resulting in multiple injuries. In the past day, military strikes across the region have caused additional deaths and casualties, adding to the high toll of lives lost during ongoing violence. These recent events contribute to thousands of civilian fatalities and injuries since the conflict escalated late last year.
